plugins.name: martix-webapi
plugins.description: Unified plugin assets for planning and implementing new net10 web apps with MartiX.WebApi guidance.

plugins.name: martix-dotnet-csharp
plugins.description: Standalone .NET 10+ and C# 14+ skill package for authoring, modernization, and review workflows, registered directly from src/skills as the single source of truth.

plugins.name: martix-fastendpoints
plugins.description: Standalone FastEndpoints skill package for startup, endpoint contracts, processors, transport choices, security, testing, versioning, and Native AOT workflows, registered directly from src/skills.

plugins.name: martix-fluentvalidation
plugins.description: Standalone FluentValidation skill package for validator authoring, built-in validator selection, RuleSets and cascade behavior, ASP.NET Core integration, async validation, extensibility, localization, testing, and upgrade planning, registered directly from src/skills.

plugins.name: martix-tunit
plugins.description: Standalone TUnit skill package for test authoring, parameterized data-driven tests, lifecycle hooks, parallel-by-default execution, async assertions, dependency injection, mocking, extensibility, and xUnit/NUnit/MSTest migration, registered directly from src/skills.

plugins.name: martix-powershell
plugins.description: Standalone PowerShell cmdlet developer skill package for compiled C# cmdlet authoring and cmdlet-style advanced functions ([CmdletBinding()]), covering base class selection (Cmdlet vs PSCmdlet), parameter declaration and validation, pipeline input/output streaming, error handling (terminating vs non-terminating), confirmation and safety patterns (ShouldProcess/Force/WhatIf), dynamic parameters, and attribute validators, registered directly from src/skills.
